title: Khoyi Hawa
prompt: Indie-fusion with breathy bansuri, plaintive sarangi, crisp modern mid-tempo beats and warm round bass, wistful and wandering yet quietly hopeful, airy organic production with spacious natural reverb, warm expressive male Hindi vocal answered by soft female harmonies, mellow earthy timbre
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Flute Interlude]

[Verse]
Subah ki halki si dhoop
Mere kandhe pe ruk gayi
Raahein khuli si lage
Dil phir se chal pada

[Pre-Chorus]
[building energy]
Hawa kuch keh rahi
Kadam halke se uth rahe

[Chorus]
Chalta jaaun main hawaon ke saath
Khoyi si raah, naye se khwaab
Door kahin ek roshni
Bula rahi mujhe, aa idhar
(aa idhar)

[Verse 2]
Mitti ki khushboo mein
Beete pal ghul gaye
Sarangi si pukaar
Seene mein bas gayi

[Bridge]
[harmonies]
Na manzil ki fikar
Na waqt ka pata
Bas yeh safar, bas yeh hawa
HAR SAANS MEIN NAYA SAVERA

[Flute Interlude]

[Outro]
Chalta jaaun, hawaon ke saath
(hawaon ke saath)
